note: External baselines. Two levels are distinguished: (a) ranking-controlled: the same AxisForge catalogue, gate and planner, only the order of examination changes; (b) full pipeline: an external system generates and selects its own grasp. Only (a) was executed, with a classical analytic criterion. No learned external detector was reproduced, and no Colab or GPU result is reported.

epsilon.note: Classical analytic ranking (force closure first, then the largest wrench-space ball of the pad contacts, computed by the planner's own measure) used as an examination order over the same candidates, stroke gate first: the ranking-controlled level. A reimplementation of a classical criterion, not a reproduction of a published system. v3 physics, torsion 0.005, nine conditions. Development parts (seeded subset, seed 20261208).

GPD (ten Pas et al. 2017).level_possible: ranking-controlled (score AxisForge candidates with GPD classifier) or full pipeline
GPD (ten Pas et al. 2017).requirements: C++ build with PCL >= 1.9, OpenCV, Eigen; CPU is enough. PCL 1.14 and OpenCV 4.6 are available through apt in this container (532 packages).
GPD (ten Pas et al. 2017).why_not_run: needs an adapter from AxisForge candidate poses to GPD hand descriptors (C++), or a bridge from GPD grasps to planner feasibility checks; not built in this phase
